speaker: Doctor
text: Can you describe the appearance and distribution of the rash on your palms, and have you noticed any similar lesions elsewhere on your body?

speaker: Patient
text: 50-year-old male. The patient reports a year-long history of an itchy rash on his upper body and face. Additionally, he has been experiencing a numbness and tingling sensation on both palms. He has been working on his family's rice farm, also caring for livestock.

speaker: Doctor
text: Have you noticed any scaling or hyperpigmentation on your palms, and has the rash improved or worsened during the winter months?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Pruritic rash on upper body and face. I also have Numbness and tingling sensation of both palms, Thinning of the eyebrows, Loss of some eyelashes, Hypopigmented macules around the elbows.

speaker: Doctor
text: Given your exposure to livestock and the presence of hypopigmented macules with alopecia, I suspect a parasitic infection. REQUEST TEST: Skin Scraping for Sarcoptes scabiei mites and eggs.

speaker: Doctor
text: Given the negative scabies test and your specific symptoms of eyebrow thinning, eyelash loss, and hypopigmented macules, I suspect a different parasitic infection. REQUEST TEST: Skin Scraping for Demodex mites.

speaker: Doctor
text: Given the negative results for scabies and Demodex, along with your specific symptoms of hypopigmented macules, alopecia, and palm involvement, I suspect Cutaneous Leishmaniasis or a similar tropical parasitic disease. REQUEST TEST: Skin Biopsy for Histopathology and PCR for Leishmania.

speaker: Doctor
text: The biopsy findings are highly specific. Do you have any history of contact with someone diagnosed with Hansen's disease, and do you experience any muscle weakness in your hands?

speaker: Patient
text: Past medical history: No significant past medical history. Social history: Works as a farmer, no history of travel outside the local area.

speaker: Doctor
text: Do you have any areas of numbness on your face or body other than your palms? Also, can you confirm if the hypopigmented macules on your elbows are anesthetic to touch?

speaker: Patient
text: Denies fever, weight loss, changes in vision, or any respiratory symptoms.

speaker: Doctor
text: The biopsy findings are diagnostic for Hansen's disease, so I will not pursue further questioning. DIAGNOSIS READY: Tuberculoid Leprosy
